# AI Resume Tailor

> AI Resume Tailor tailors an existing resume to a specific job posting and reports an ATS keyword-match score. It is free to try with no login required, the first 3 tailored resumes are free, and paid access is a one-time purchase — there is no subscription and nothing auto-renews.

## Key facts

- **Free to try, no login required.** Paste a resume and a job description to get the keyword-match score and the missing-keyword list without creating an account.
- **Free tier:** the first 3 tailored resumes are free, including viewing and downloading them (PDF or Markdown). No credit card required.
- **Pricing:** one-time access passes — 2 days $9.00, 1 week $19.00, 1 month $29.00 (USD). Not a subscription; nothing auto-renews; there is nothing to cancel.
- **What it does:** rewrites the candidate's own resume so it matches the wording of one specific job posting, with ATS-friendly formatting, a keyword-match score, the keywords missing from the resume, and a plain-English explanation of what changed and why.
- **How it works:** a multi-step pipeline profiles the resume, analyses the job posting, plans bullet-level changes, rewrites them, then validates the result. Question generation and rewriting run on low-cost inference, which is what keeps the free tier free.
- **Honesty constraint:** it does not invent metrics or inflate scope. A rewrite that fails an authenticity check is dropped and the original wording is kept, so output cannot contain achievements the source resume does not support.
- **Scope limits:** it does not claim to replicate any specific ATS vendor's algorithm, and it does not guarantee interviews or outcomes. A match score measures keyword overlap with one posting — it is a filter to clear, not a promise.

## Core pages

- [Free ATS Resume Checker](https://airesumetailor.com/resume-checker): ATS compatibility score, layout and header checks, missing-keyword detection, and action-verb strength.
- [Resume Optimizer](https://airesumetailor.com/resume-optimizer): Tailors a resume to a job description with keyword matching and human-sounding output.
- [Pricing](https://airesumetailor.com/pricing): One-time access tiers; the first 3 tailored resumes are free.
- [FAQ](https://airesumetailor.com/faq): Resume tailoring, ATS scoring, and pricing questions.
- [Blog](https://airesumetailor.com/blog): Guides on resume tailoring, ATS compatibility, and role-specific keywords.
